title: aciphylla decipiens
intro: Aciphylla decipiens, commonly known as New Zealand angelica or parsnip tree, is a perennial plant native to New Zealand. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing pain and promoting overall well-being. The plant's therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Aciphylla decipiens include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
